sources.note: Main vendor homepage. Describes E*HealthLine as 'a leader in Integrated Health Care Information Management software and services.' Lists CARE, Phoenix, eLab, eRad, PACS, eBilling, and many other products across hospital, physician practice, managed care, telehealth, and pharma categories.

Full product listing page. Revealed the extensive product portfolio organized into categories: Hospital & Health Systems, Physician Practices, Clinical Decision Support, Health Plan/Managed Care, Telehealth, Care Continuum, Population Health, Patient Engagement, Radiology/Imaging, Financial/Billing, Pharmacy, Business Intelligence, Interoperability, and Pharmaceutical products.

CARE HIS overview page. Describes CARE as 'an integrated hospital information system providing comprehensive applications.' Lists core modules: ADT, Bed Management, Scheduling, Patient Care, LIS, RIS, Material Management, Inventory Control, Patient Billing.

CARE Chart product page. Described as 'The Comprehensive Electronic Medical Record and Data Repository' covering charts, flow sheets, ordering, and clinical documentation. Limited detail beyond marketing language.
CARE Clinical Foundation page. Described as 'An open repository for clinical information that provides the Foundation with Electronic Health/Medical Record Management.' Very minimal detail.

CARE CPOE page. Centralizes and automates workflow for physicians, nurses, pharmacists, and caregivers. Includes allergy flags/alerts, decision-making templates, real-time patient status. Reduces medication errors.

eLab LIS page. Most detailed product page found. Manages complete clinical order lifecycle: test orders, specimen collection/routing, testing, reflex testing, QA/auto-verification, report creation/distribution via hard copy/fax/email/HL7. Integrates with analyzers and billing.

eRad RIS page. Covers patient registration, order entry, exam tracking, film tracking, transcription, e-signatures, report distribution. Integrates with PACS. Includes scheduling for multi-modality procedures and speech recognition.

eBilling product page (listed under Physician Practices but also referenced from Hospital modules). Provides patient liability assessment, claims editing/validation, account histories, EDI services. Aims to 'eliminate inefficiencies and improve reimbursement.'

About page. Describes company as 'multi-institutional and multi-disciplinary organization' delivering 'an integrated Connected Health Platform.' No concrete details about company size, history, customers, or leadership.
Telehealth products page. Lists TeleHealth (enterprise telehealth/mHealth) and TeleMed (patient-centered medical home) systems. Minimal detail.
Health Plan/Managed Care products. Lists Eternity suite: managed care, provider portal, ACO, EDI, EClaims, EScan, E*enrollment, Care Management, Disease Management. Separate product line from CARE.
ONC mandatory disclosures document. PDF was not parseable (encrypted/compressed binary). Could not extract text content.

BBB profile. Located at 2450 Venture Oaks Way, Ste #100, Sacramento, CA 95823. Founded May 24, 1999. 26 years in business. President: Yousuy Mekhamen. Not BBB accredited, not rated. No complaints or reviews on file. Categorized as 'Business Consultants.'
Manta business listing. Referenced in search results showing Sacramento, CA location. Page returned 403 when fetched directly.
ZoomInfo listing. Referenced in search results indicating ~$5.3M revenue, ~7 employees, and Burbank, CA as an alternate location. Could not access directly.
LinkedIn company page found in search results. Not accessed directly (requires authentication).
